title: Recover operation-backend Contracts and Templates adapter

input.requestedOutcome: Recover and review the dirty S3 Contracts/Templates frontend work, then commit only the S3 adapter, tag, focused test, task report, and manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: Promo create/edit/void uses confirmed operation-backend contract endpoints.
Documents display confirmed records read-only without artifact upload or metadata mapping.
Syntax, focused tests, and diff checks pass.
constraints: No backend, database, schema, migration, or DB changes.
No push and no unrelated files.
Keep the script classic and ordered before 90-ops-boot.js.
Do not implement the explicitly BLOCKED legacy artifact metadata/upload mapping.
assumptions: The recovered dirty adapter, tag, and test were created by the usage-limited Luna worker.
D:/projects/operation-backend is the authoritative API implementation.

output.summary: Recovered and corrected the S3 adapter: operation-backend is authoritative for promo contracts and templates in ops mode; confirmed document records display read-only; blocked legacy artifact behavior remains unavailable.

filesChanged.purpose: Load the S3 adapter before ops boot as a classic script.
Map contract/template APIs, read-only documents, and legacy entry-point wrappers.
Test mappings, create-versus-PATCH payload behavior, artifact blocking, and tag order.
Record the S3 implementation and verification evidence.

behaviorChanges.before: Legacy local contract persistence was used.
behaviorChanges.after: Ops mode loads server contracts and writes promo create/edit/void to /v1/contracts; PATCH excludes create-only agent_id.

behaviorChanges.before: Legacy template seed/blob writers could persist local changes.
behaviorChanges.after: Ops mode loads server details and writes template mutations, including reset/default/delete, to /v1/contract-templates.

behaviorChanges.before: The legacy wizard stored generated artifact metadata in the browser.
behaviorChanges.after: Ops mode displays existing server documents read-only and blocks unverified artifact generation/history mapping.

changed: Legacy contract, template, renewal, and document entry points in operations mode

details: Uses existing operation-backend contract and template write endpoints.
Does not write legacy localStorage contract, template, or artifact stores in operations mode.
No database schema or migration change.

verification.evidence: Operation-backend suite completed successfully, including contracts coverage.

verification.command: git diff --check and untracked-file whitespace checks

decisions: Preserved and reviewed the recovered worker implementation instead of discarding it.
Removed agent_id from PATCH payloads because the backend accepts it only on POST create.
Wrapped cttResetKey so template resets cannot silently mutate only local browser state.
Blocked artifact reopen rather than translating legacy artifact ids into server document metadata.
risks: No browser/live API end-to-end run was performed.
Legacy UI copy still says document generation although ops mode is intentionally read-only.
blockers: Exact legacy generated-artifact metadata/upload mapping is explicitly BLOCKED and intentionally absent.
followUps: Define a verified server-side document generation/artifact metadata contract before replacing the legacy document wizard/history UX.
rollback: Revert the S3 implementation and metadata commits; no database rollback is needed.
